brief: Create docs/backup.md: a guide titled "Backing Up Your App", about 40 lines, with exactly three sections in this order: "## Why Volume-Level Backups Win" (contrast in-app exports with volume-level backups), "## Weekly Schedule" (weekly cadence, three retention rotations, one off-site copy), "## Restore Drill" (a monthly drill in three numbered steps). House style: short sentences, active voice, no filler words. Markdown only.

Rewrite the paragraph in docs/upload-guide.md in place. Cut every filler phrase ("it should be noted", "actually", "basically", "in order to", "it is important to note", and the like). Keep every fact: the admin panel is in the upper right-hand corner, the button is labeled "Upload", supported formats include PDF, DOCX, and TXT, and a failed upload should be retried later. Keep the heading unchanged. Short sentences, active voice.

In src/metrics.py, in place: add a one-line docstring to every function saying what it returns, and move the `import math` from inside zscore to the top of the module. Change nothing else: no renames, no logic changes, no new functions, keep the blank-line layout.

Fix the bug in src/paginate.py: paginate drops the final short page when len(items) is not a multiple of page_size. The docstring already states the intended behaviour. Keep the function name, signature, and docstring. Change nothing else.

Create docs/runbook.md: the operations runbook for Ledgerly, a self-hosted bookkeeping app that runs as one container with a named volume. Title line: "# Ledgerly Operations Runbook". Then a contents list: one bullet per section, each a markdown link to that section's anchor (e.g. [Daily Checks](#daily-checks)). Then exactly these eight sections, in this order, each a "## " heading: "Daily Checks", "Weekly Backups", "Restore From Backup", "Upgrading", "Rotating Secrets", "Disk Space", "Incident Response", "Decommissioning". Each section: one short paragraph on why it matters, then at least five numbered steps (1. 2. 3. ...), one concrete action per step, naming real commands where it helps (ledgerly status, ledgerly backup, ledgerly update, docker logs). Aim for 9,000 to 12,000 characters in total. House style: short sentences, active voice, no filler, no placeholders. Markdown only.

Rewrite docs/install-guide.md in place, to well under two thirds of its length. Cut every filler phrase ("it should be noted that", "basically", "in order to", "it is important to note that", "as a matter of fact", "needless to say", "actually", "whatsoever") and every sentence that says nothing. Keep: the title line unchanged; all six "## " headings unchanged and in order; every fenced code block byte for byte; every URL; each section's one real fact. Short sentences, active voice.
